description: Every Zoho Campaigns operation, plus report history, offline search, and headless self-refreshing OAuth no other tool has.

novel_features.name: Report delta
novel_features.description: See how one campaign's opens, clicks, bounces, and unsubscribes changed between snapshots — the trajectory Zoho never shows.

novel_features.name: Org digest
novel_features.description: One-shot rollup of everything sent in a window: aggregate open/click/bounce rates, list totals, and biggest movers.

novel_features.name: List growth
novel_features.description: Per-list subscriber, unsubscribe, and bounce trend lines over time — is the list growing or bleeding.

novel_features.name: Engagement ranking
novel_features.description: Rank contacts by engagement across ALL campaigns — most engaged, or dead weight that never opens.

novel_features.name: Bounce audit
novel_features.description: Bounced contacts joined to current list membership — deliverability cleanup candidates, pipeable into do-not-mail.

novel_features.name: Contact journey
novel_features.description: One contact's chronological history across every campaign — what they received, opened, and clicked.
